faqs.question: Does this POS Software work online and offline?
faqs.answer: Yes, this POS software works in offline mode and automatically syncs sales, inventory, and reports once you're back online, keeping your business running.

faqs.question: What payment plans does myPOS offer?
faqs.answer: myPOS offers flexible monthly and annual plans for our software based on your features and number of locations, so you only pay for what you need.

faqs.question: Does myPOS integrate with FBR and PRA?
faqs.answer: Yes, myPOS is a POS system with built-in FBR and PRA integration, keeping your business tax-compliant with digital sales reporting instead of manual filing.

faqs.question: Why should I choose myPOS?
faqs.answer: myPOS is a reliable POS software offering offline access, FBR/PRA compliance, multi-location support, and dedicated customer support for businesses across Pakistan.

faqs.question: How long does setup and installation take?
faqs.answer: Most businesses have their POS system fully set up within 1 to 3 days, including installation, data migration, product setup, and staff training.

faqs.question: Can I try a demo before purchasing myPOS?
faqs.answer: Yes, we offer a free demo so you can explore our point of sale features and see how it fits your business before committing.

faqs.question: What kind of customer support do you offer?
faqs.answer: Our POS software comes with ongoing phone, WhatsApp, and email support, plus remote assistance and staff training whenever you need help.

faqs.question: Can multiple users have different access levels?
faqs.answer: Yes, this POS system supports role-based access, letting you control what cashiers, managers, and admins can see and do.

faqs.question: Can I manage multiple business locations with myPOS?
faqs.answer: Yes, myPOS lets you monitor sales, inventory, and staff across all branches from one dashboard, store by store or consolidated.

faqs.question: Is my business data secure with myPOS?
faqs.answer: Yes, this POS system uses encrypted cloud storage with regular backups and access controls, keeping your data safe and accessible only to authorized staff.
